summary:
Steps 1 to 3 of the Retain plan are implemented in copy B (/home/wanhr/sglang/agent_cache/frozen/impl_unified_B) behind four switches, all off by default, with CPU unit tests. With the switches off the engine behaves as before: all 122 unit test files of test/registered/unit/mem_cache give the same outcome for every case, no existing test body was changed, and the h2s_done line is byte-identical.

Three limits to know first:
- REPORT.md is not on disk. The Write tool refused it ("Subagents should return findings as text, not write report files") and I did not write it another way. This output is its full content; the caller has to save it to /home/wanhr/sglang/agent_cache/results/design_unified_1126/impl/B/REPORT.md if the file is wanted.
- Nothing ran on a GPU or with more than one rank. All evidence is CPU unit tests.
- The merge with copy A was not built or tested (merge notes below).

What was built
- R3 (SGLANG_HICACHE_STORAGE_TRACK_STORED): a tree node counts as stored on the SSD only after an ack that covers all its pages, agreed over ranks. Pages read back from the SSD are stored at birth. A child's write first rewrites the host-backed ancestors that have no SSD copy and no write queued (the heal). Clear and detach reset the marks.
- X1: NextTurnPrefetcher.ends_session(req, reply_known=...) is true only when the hint states the end: a table entry marked ended, or an exact-hint turn that the previous turn named and that names no next turn. Under the R1 or the retire switch the registration follows it: no usable entry, an expired plan and an abort forget the session's tail (it ranks as un-hinted) instead of registering it as ended.
- R4 refresh (SGLANG_HICACHE_NIXL_TOUCH_INTERVAL_S): a request's match hands the page keys of the stored chain it was served to a touch thread in HiCacheNixl, head first. The thread stamps the head newest and each later page 1 ms older. A page is touched at most once per interval. No file system call runs on the scheduler thread.
- R1 (SGLANG_HICACHE_STORAGE_SKIP_ENDED_WRITES): the inserts of a turn whose hint ends its session keep their host copy and get no SSD write (no operation, no host lock, no pending tokens).
- R4 retire (SGLANG_HICACHE_NIXL_RETIRE_ENDED_PAGES): at an explicit end the session's own stored pages get mtime zero and stop counting as stored. Own means past the session's first prompt and on no branch another session built on, including the session's replies that no later prompt repeated. First prompts are never retired. A page whose write is queued, or whose host copy is still in flight, is zeroed at the ack of its write. The cleaner (nixl_cleaner.py) is unchanged, as are scheduler.py, tokenizer_manager.py and model_runner.py.

Evidence
- 30 tests added to five existing test files; no test file added.
- 64 single-line mutations of the engine, each run against the test meant to catch it: all killed on the final code. Two survived when first written and showed real holes, closed by extending their test (the skip set was never emptied; an exact-hint end was not retired at commit).
- The ten named test files were last run at 5:32 PM ET on 2026-11-26; counts are in test_results.
- ruff format and ruff check (F401, F821, UP037; ruff 0.16.10 from the uv cache) show nothing new in the changed lines, except the h2s_done call, kept on one line with its EVAL-PATCH mark as before.

Log events (each appears only under its switch)
- h2s_done ... stored=<0|1>, appended at the end, with TRACK_STORED on.
- h2s_short op= node= tokens= completed=, on an ack that did not cover every page.
- h2s_skip node= tokens= reason=ended, at each skipped write.
- ntp_end rid= sess= explicit=<0|1> why=<entry|no_next|no_entry|expired|abort>.
- l3_retire node= pages= at_ack= keep_tokens=, at an explicit end (pages zeroed now, pages left to their ack).
- l3_retire_ack op= node= pages=, when a retire left to the ack is done.
- l3_touch files= gone=, from the touch thread, at most every 10 s and at stop.
- At start-up, when a switch is asked for: "HiCache retention: track_stored= skip_ended_writes= touch_interval_s= retire_ended_pages=" and "HiCacheNixl: touch_interval_s= retire_ended_pages=". A switch that lacks what it needs logs "HiCache retention: <name> stays off: it needs ...".

First campaign arm
Set the planner's four: SGLANG_HICACHE_STORAGE_TRACK_STORED=1 SGLANG_HICACHE_NIXL_TOUCH_INTERVAL_S=300 SGLANG_HICACHE_NIXL_RETIRE_ENDED_PAGES=1 SGLANG_HICACHE_STORAGE_SKIP_ENDED_WRITES=1.
- Compare with the same arm with all four unset, and run past the first cleaner pass (minute 87.5 to 88.3 at campaign 34's setting). Keep the baseline's other switches the same in both.
- It needs what the hinted arms already have: the prefetcher on, host memory mode cache, write-through, the NIXL file backend, TP = 1, a FULL-only model, and hints that state the end.
- The start-up line must read track_stored=1 skip_ended_writes=1 touch_interval_s=300 retire_ended_pages=1, with no "stays off" warning.
- This arm also gets X1's registration change. An arm with TRACK_STORED and the touch interval alone needs no hints and isolates the refresh.
- What to read: h2s_skip (the plan counts 4.7 to 4.8 % of inserted tokens in campaign 34), ntp_end explicit=1 (566 sessions in ec_full) against explicit=0 why=no_entry|expired (the false ends of before), l3_retire and l3_retire_ack, l3_touch files= per second (the utime load), stored=0 and h2s_short (none expected). The effect to look for: after each "NIXL L3 cleanup", fewer s2h_query storage_hit=0 on returning turns and fewer "failed to retrieve page".

switches: SGLANG_HICACHE_STORAGE_TRACK_STORED: gates the stored marks on tree nodes (stored only after an ack that covers every page, agreed over ranks), the heal (a child's write first rewrites host-backed ancestors with no SSD copy), the mark resets at clear and detach, stored= on h2s_done and the h2s_short line. Default off (EnvBool False). Needs --hicache-host-memory-mode cache and the Python tree core; otherwise it stays off with one warning.

SGLANG_HICACHE_NIXL_TOUCH_INTERVAL_S: gates the touch thread in HiCacheNixl and the match_prefix hook that refreshes the mtime of the stored chain a request was served, head newest; the value is the least seconds between two refreshes of a page. Default 0.0 = off (EnvFloat; the extra-config key touch_interval_s wins over the env). Needs TRACK_STORED and a NIXL file backend that writes files on this rank.

SGLANG_HICACHE_STORAGE_SKIP_ENDED_WRITES: gates the skip of the SSD write for the inserts of a turn whose hint ends its session (h2s_skip), and turns on X1's registration (only an explicit end registers a session as ended; ntp_end lines). Default off (EnvBool False). Needs TRACK_STORED and the next-turn prefetcher (--hicache-storage-next-turn-prefetch observe or on, which itself admits TP = PP = 1 only).

SGLANG_HICACHE_NIXL_RETIRE_ENDED_PAGES: gates mtime zero for an explicitly ended session's own pages (l3_retire), the same at the ack for pages still on their way (l3_retire_ack), the touch thread, and X1's registration. Default off (EnvBool False; the extra-config key retire_ended_pages wins over the env). Needs TRACK_STORED, the next-turn prefetcher, a FULL-only cache without sidecar pools, and a NIXL file backend.

How they are resolved: once per cache into the frozen struct cache.retention, at the end of init_hicache and again at a runtime attach of a storage backend. The two STORAGE switches are read from the environment by the cache; the two NIXL switches by NixlBackendConfig, published on the store and read off it by the cache. The prefetcher gets explicit_ends and retire_ended from its factory. With all four off: no mark is asked of the tree, no thread is started, no file is touched, no decision changes and no existing HICACHE_EVT line changes.

deviations: R4 refresh, what counts as stale. In the pseudo-diff a node's stamp starts at zero and only a refresh sets it, so every written page is stale from birth and each turn's first match touches its session's whole stored chain: up to about 12.8 M utime calls in campaign 34's ec_full (410.48 M ideal cached tokens of returning turns / 64 tokens a page x 2 files; my upper bound), against the 1.72 M the plan's own count gives at 300 s. Built instead: a full ack stamps the node, and one stale stored node refreshes every stored node of the served chain, head first, so each page is touched at most once per interval. Cost of the choice: pages written since the last refresh are newer than their head until the next refresh.

Dependencies added to the plan's list. The refresh needs TRACK_STORED (its walk reads the stored mark; without it only read-back nodes would be refreshed). TRACK_STORED needs host memory mode cache (in buffer_only an ack carries no node) and the Python tree core (the marks are fields of its nodes). Retire needs a FULL-only cache without sidecar pools (the cleaner ranks a page by its newest file and only the KV files are touched).

Retire, whose leaf. The pseudo-diff takes an off-path leaf as the session's own when it is not registered for next use, and calls retire before the commit registers the new tail. At that point the session's previous reply is still registered, so the walk stops one node above the last turn and retires nothing older; X1 also makes 'not registered' unsafe, since it forgets the tails of live sessions. Built instead: the prefetcher records per session its first prompt length and the node each turn committed, and a leaf is own only if it is one of those.

Retire, smaller points. A node whose host copy is still in flight (no write queued yet) is also left to its ack, and split fragments inherit that. The own replies hanging off the first-prompt node are taken. The session name comes from the table when the rid chain is broken (after a turn with no usable entry or an expired plan). The first prompt is the first one committed, with or without a usable entry, and is kept until the explicit end (bounded by REGISTRY_MAX_ENTRIES). A pending node whose write R1 will skip is not queued for the ack. at_ack= counts pages. l3_retire_ack is an extra log line.

Retire at the ack. The pseudo-diff calls finish_storage_write a second time with stored=False; the first call has already cleared the operation id, so the second finds nothing and the node stays stored. Built: one call with the final verdict.

ends_session. In the pseudo-diff a next-turn action that cannot be read falls into the exact-hint branch and ends the session of a named turn. Built: a next-turn action that is present and unreadable ends nothing.

Rank agreement. The stored verdict is reduced with _all_reduce (TP minimum on PP rank 0, then the PP sync) whenever TP > 1 or PP > 1. The pseudo-diff uses _all_reduce_attn_groups over TP only, which would let PP ranks mark, heal and count acks differently.
Heal. An ancestor whose host copy is still in flight is skipped; its own ack writes it. The pseudo-diff would queue a write of a copy that is not complete.
h2s_done. stored= is appended only with TRACK_STORED on (the plan appends it always), so the line stays byte-identical for every existing arm, as the switch contract requires.

Switch state. One frozen struct on the cache (cache.retention, class default all off) in a new module storage_retention.py, instead of four attributes: caches that the existing tests build without __init__ then see every switch off. It is resolved again at a runtime attach, and the two NIXL switches are read off the attached store instead of the environment, so the extra-config keys are honoured.
finish_storage_write takes stored_at (the time of a full ack, or None) instead of stored: bool, because the ack also stamps the node for the refresh.

environ.py has only the four switches of steps 1 to 3; the other five of 00_environ.diff belong to steps 4 to 6. They sit before SGLANG_HICACHE_NEXT_TURN_ROOM_RETRY, because someone else added a switch after that line in the real tree during the work.

R1 limits. A one-request session that ends explicitly does not get its first prompt written (1 of 566 ended sessions in campaign 34); the heal writes it once a session that does not end extends it while it is in memory. R1 acts where the insert makes the host copy: under write_through_selective it also covers an earlier node whose copy the ending turn triggers, and under write_back it does nothing. An aborted last turn whose hint states the end is skipped too, while the commit hook forgets its session without retiring it.

Retire limits. It stops at a leaf it does not know, so a reply left by an aborted turn keeps everything above it un-retired. A session seen for one turn only is not retired. The stored verdict covers the KV pages only (exact for FULL-only stacks).
The prefetcher's two end switches are fixed when it is created: a storage backend attached at runtime with another setting changes the cache, not the prefetcher.
